author: Shersarran
quote: Extremely disappointed with GTA 6.Honestly, this doesn’t feel like the GTA we grew up playing and loved. Instead of the raw, rebellious, chaotic experience that made GTA iconic, it feels like a boyfriend-simp simulator dressed up as **** whole direction feels forced, with unnecessary relationship drama and what seems like an attempt to push a woke narrative rather than deliver the unapologetic GTA experience fans have been waiting **** was always about freedom, crime, satire, dark humour, memorable characters, and absolute chaos. Not turning the experience into a relationship **** graphics and technical ambition might be impressive, but that alone doesn’t make a great GTA game. Rockstar needs to remember what made this franchise legendary in the first place.This doesn’t feel like the GTA I waited years for. It’s a disappointment.
